entries.german:
1379. 7. Mai. Prag. — Derselbe verleiht auf Bitten derselben dem Kloster гu Hohenfurt, dann der Kirche zur heiligen Maria Magdalena und de.m Elisabe- thenspitale bei dem genannten Kloster einige Induigenzen.

Pileus miseracione diuina tituli sanete Praxedis presbyter car- dinalis ad infrascripta apostolica auctoritate suffulti vniuersis Christi fidelibus presentes litteras inspecturis salutem in domino. Splendor paterne glorie, qui sua muudum illuminat ineflabili claritatc, pin uota fidelium de clementissima ipsius maiestate sperancium tune precipue pio fauore prosequitur, eum ipsorum deuota humilitas sanctorum precibus el merilis adiuuatur, ac Christi fideles eo libencius ad deuocionem confluent, quo ibidem dono celestis gratie conspexerint se refectos. Cum igitur dilecte in Christo Petrus prepusitus capelle omnium sanctorum in castro Pragensi et Johannes fratres germani de Rosemberg barones regni Boemie ad monasterium in Atowado ordinis sancti Bernhardi et ecclesiam sanete Marie Magdalene in porta ipsius monasterii ac hospitale sanete Elizabeth in foribus eius- dem monasterii situatum Pragensis diocesis specialem gerunt affec- tionem et deuocionem, prout accepimus, nobisque humiliter suppli- carunt, ut pro deuocione ipsius augmentanda spiritualia munera largiri dignaremur, nos igitur dictis supplicacionibus fauorabiliter annuentes de omipoteutis (sie) dei misericordia ac sanclorum Pétri et Pauli apostolorum eius meritis et auctoritate predicta confisi om nibus uere penitentibus et cunfessis, qui dictum monasterium et ecclesiam ac hospitale deuote uisitauerint in festiuitatibus infra- scriptis, videlicet natiuitatis resurrectionis ascensionis domini nostri Jesu Christi penthecosten ac corporis Chiisti et in siugulis festiui- tatibus beate Marie virginis ac sanctorum apostolorum necnon qua tuor doctorum Ambrosii Augusti ni Jeronimi Gregorii necnon patro- norum ac dedicacione dicti monasterii et ecclesie ac hospitalis, pro cuiuslibet dictorum luconim uisitucione centum dies de iniunctis eis 179 peniteueiis prelihate auctoriíate misericorditer relaxamus. Datum Prage Non. Maii. Pontificatus sanctissimi in Christo patris et domini nostri domini Vrbani prouidencia pape vi. anno secundo. Jo. Bouenhert (?). R. S. entries.english:
7 May 1379, Prague. At their request, the same cardinal grants certain indulgences to the monastery of Hohenfurt, the church of St. Mary Magdalene and the Hospital of St. Elizabeth by that monastery.

Pileus, by divine mercy cardinal priest of the title of St. Praxedis, supported by apostolic authority for the matters set out below, to all the faithful of Christ who shall see these letters, greetings in the Lord. The radiance of the Father's glory, which illuminates the world with its ineffable brightness, follows with gracious favor the pious prayers of the faithful who hope in his most merciful majesty, especially when their devout humility is aided by the prayers and merits of the saints. The faithful of Christ will gather for devotion all the more willingly when they see themselves refreshed there by the gift of heavenly grace.

As we have learned, our beloved in Christ Peter von Rosenberg, provost of the chapel of All Saints in Prague Castle, and Hans von Rosenberg, brothers of the whole blood and barons of the kingdom of Bohemia, have a special affection and devotion for the monastery at Atowado of the order of St. Bernard, the church of St. Mary Magdalene at the gate of that monastery, and the Hospital of St. Elizabeth situated at the entrance of the same monastery, in the diocese of Prague. They have humbly asked us to bestow spiritual gifts to increase devotion there.

Therefore, favorably granting these requests, and trusting in the mercy of almighty God, the merits of his apostles Saints Peter and Paul, and the aforesaid authority, we mercifully remit one hundred days of the penances imposed on all those who are truly penitent and have confessed, for each of the said places that they devoutly visit on the following feasts: the Nativity, Resurrection and Ascension of our Lord Jesus Christ, Pentecost and Corpus Christi; each feast of the Blessed Virgin Mary and of the holy apostles; the feasts of the four doctors Ambrose, Augustine, Jerome and Gregory; and the feasts of the patrons and the dedications of the said monastery, church and hospital.

Given at Prague on the Nones of May, in the second year of the pontificate of our most holy father and lord in Christ, Pope Urban VI, by providence pope. Jo. Bouenhert (?); R. S. For the seal, see the preceding charter.
